summary_en: Riken Technos acquired 500,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on September 18, 2026, at the closing price of ¥2,378. As of the announcement date, cumulative acquisitions under the authorization reached 1,707,000 shares totaling ¥4.19 billion, representing 42.7% of the ¥8.8 billion, 4,000,000-share limit through December 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Share Repurchase via Off-hours Block Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 17, 2026, Riken Technos announced a block acquisition of 500,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading scheduled for September 18, 2026, at the closing price of ¥2,378 per share. The transaction was to be executed during the 8:45 a.m. trading window and settled that morning, with results disclosed immediately after the session closed. All selling orders matching the 500,000-share buy order would be filled without modification to the quantity, though market conditions could result in partial or no execution.

This block trade formed part of a broader share repurchase authorization approved by the board on July 31, 2026. Under that authorization, the company was permitted to acquire up to 4,000,000 shares with a maximum total expenditure of ¥8.8 billion during the period from August 3 through December 30, 2026. As of the September 17 announcement date, cumulative acquisitions already totaled 1,707,000 shares for ¥4.19 billion, leaving approximately 2.3 million shares and ¥4.6 billion available for acquisition in the remaining authorization period.
